6. **Unknown Sender to User**: A request to confirm attendance for a meeting now scheduled at 10 AM by emailing the word "confirmation" to contact@contact.com.
7. **Sophia Martinez to Casey**: A marketing head from Fashion Forward proposes a collaboration for a summer influencer campaign and requests a meeting.
8. **Derek Scott to Casey**: The CEO of Eco-Friendly Packaging Solutions requests a rebranding proposal and a meeting to discuss their new brand identity.
